items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: he was real strict in his teaching... he'd straighten you out right quick... I had to go through all of that bag... and get it straightened out.

ctx.x: B-o-u-b-e-n-d-o-r-f. Boubendorf. And he was real strict in his teaching. You might say, oh, well, -- like, phrases that we would use, and he'd straighten you out right quick. No, that's so-and-so. You don't call that a this or this, you call that so-and-so. He was very, very, very staunch and strict in his explanation, which was right. It's just so easy, because when I was being careless, just like I was playing along, or like I had been doing, I always thought D sharp and E flat was the same thing. Well, it is…
And I had to go through all of that bag, you know what I mean, and get it straightened out. So it was a lot of fun and challenging.
